item_name: Rothco G.I. Style Canteen and Cover
item_short_desc: Stay hydrated during your outdoor adventures with Rothco’s Canteen and Cover. Made from durable aluminum, this canteen can hold up to 1 quart of water, ensuring a reliable supply on the go. The included polyester canteen cover is felt-lined for insulation, helping to maintain the water's temperature. It features a 2-button snap closure for secure storage and easy access. Whether you’re hiking, camping, or exploring the great outdoors, this lightweight canteen is the perfect addition to your gear collection.
